examples.explanation: After storing 1, 3, 5: 4 equals 1 + 3 (yes -> 1), while no pair sums to 7 (no -> 0).
The two stored zeros sum to 0. A pair must use two different stored entries, which exists here.
A single stored 5 cannot pair with itself; 10 also has no pair yet.

hints: Keep counts of each added number so duplicates are handled.
For a find(value), check whether value - x was seen for some stored x, requiring a count of at least 2 when both picks are the same number.
title: 320. Two Sum III - Data Structure Design
